outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of Tmprss11b normalized counts across mouse models, but individual data points (colored dots, one per biological replicate) are overlaid on each bar, allowing assessment of variability and sample size.
Panel B is a schematic illustration of the experimental workflow, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C shows representative MRI photographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D shows representative H&E micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel E shows H&E and RNAscope micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel F shows representative H&E and immunofluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G shows H&E and RNAscope micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
